title: Keep more of what you earn
description: Cut provincial income tax by raising the basic personal exemption to the most generous level in the country, delivering $1,000 a year in relief per person ($2,000 for a couple), and remove NDP taxes on income, cars and business costs.
original_quote: We will cut your income tax by raising the provincial personal exemption to the most generous level in the country and we will take the NDP's taxes off your income, your car and your business costs.
metric: $1,000 per person / $2,000 per couple per year

title: Stop TransLink's car tax
description: Amend the South Coast British Columbia Transportation Authority Act so TransLink cannot impose a tax or levy on owning or registering a car.
original_quote: Stop TransLink's car tax. Amend the South Coast British Columbia Transportation Authority Act so TransLink cannot put a tax or levy on owning or registering a car.

title: Protect driver choice
description: End the zero-emission vehicle sales quota so British Columbians can choose the vehicle that works for their family and work.
original_quote: Protect driver choice. End the zero-emission vehicle sales quota and you choose the vehicle that works for your family and work.

title: Make a new home cheaper to build and buy
description: Cut construction taxes and unnecessary charges, restore energy choice for home heating and cooking, speed approvals so homes come to market in months rather than years, align municipal zoning with Official Community Plans, give local governments control over density, shorten approvals for family-oriented growth, ensure growth comes with roads, transit, health care, schools and utilities, and overhaul the step code and simplify the building code.
original_quote: Make a new home cheaper to build and buy

title: Help families when it counts
description: Expand affordable child care by removing regulations that block new spaces, fund independent providers fairly and make them eligible for $10-a-day spaces, prioritize $10-a-day spaces for highest-need families, create 24-hour spaces for shift workers and first responders, increase the BC Family Benefit and Affordable Child Care Benefit, match the federal Multigenerational Home Renovation Tax Credit, and speed credential recognition for child care providers.
original_quote: Help families when it counts

title: Keep auto insurance affordable
description: Maintain ICBC as a public option and preserve no-fault for the vast majority of claims, while giving catastrophically injured victims access to legal representation with capped legal fees so costs don't drive up premiums or reduce victim payouts.
original_quote: Keep auto insurance affordable by maintaining ICBC as a public option and preserving no-fault for the vast majority of claims, while giving catastrophically injured victims access to legal representation, with capped legal fees so lawyers' costs don't drive up premiums or reduce what accident victims receive.

title: Bring fiscal responsibility back to government
description: Appoint an independent panel of experts to review and report on the government's true fiscal position, chart a realistic path back to balance with spending benchmarks and guardrails while growing the economy, restore merit-based hiring, end duplication and poor management, hold agencies accountable, and turn Metro Vancouver into a lean, accountable regional utility with a professional board.
original_quote: Bring fiscal responsibility back to government

title: Build responsibly: review and fix David Eby's capital mess
description: Conduct a thorough review and audit of the provincial capital plan to establish clear priorities, realistic budgets, delivery schedules and stronger oversight, reporting findings within six months; restore broad competitive bidding for provincial infrastructure; build a new George Massey Bridge instead of the tunnel; complete the new Surrey hospital and build a new women's and children's hospital in Surrey; and audit SkilledTradesBC.
original_quote: We will bring discipline, predictability and transparency to capital spending. A Conservative government will: Conduct a thorough, comprehensive review and audit of the provincial capital plan

title: Supercharge Investment & Create Opportunity
description: Make BC an energy superpower by expanding natural gas and LNG; permanently cancel the NDP's PST expansion to professional services; exempt productive capital from PST for three years; cut red tape to 2017 levels with a one-in, two-out law and legislated approval timelines; create a First Job Tax Credit on the first $5,000 of payroll; appoint a blue-ribbon tax reform panel; and repeal CleanBC.
original_quote: We will: Make BC an energy superpower by expanding natural gas and LNG development, doubling natural gas production by 2032 and tripling it by 2035.
metric: double natural gas by 2032, triple by 2035; red tape to 2017 levels by end of first term; tax panel report within 180 days

title: Make BC a place to build
description: Cut red tape, bring certainty to approvals and make government a constructive partner for investors, including working with industry in good faith, streamlining government costs, trusting certified professionals, imposing no PST on designated major projects until in service, and pursuing a new BC defence industry with a veterans workforce strategy.
original_quote: We will cut red tape, bring certainty to approvals, and make government a constructive partner for people who want to invest in our province.

title: Put resource communities back to work
description: Restore confidence in forestry, mining, energy and agriculture by cutting red tape, speeding up permits for vital projects, and supporting more production and processing at home.
original_quote: We will quickly restore confidence in these industries, cut red tape and speed up permits for vital projects, and support more production and processing here at home.

title: Become an energy superpower
description: Back natural gas and LNG industries, expand domestic electricity supply and build connections to green light new investment; double natural gas production by 2032 and triple by 2035; expand port, rail and transportation capacity including Fraser Canyon rail, Lower Mainland grade separations and Roberts Bank and Prince Rupert port expansions; speed major project decisions with First Nations and industry; address grid connection backlogs; and become the fastest place in North America to permit a mine and LNG facility with annual public progress reports.
original_quote: Our BC Energy Superpower Plan will do just that. We will back our natural gas and LNG industries, expand domestic electricity supply and build the connections that will green light new investment.
metric: double natural gas by 2032, triple by 2035; at least $6 billion a year in revenue

title: Get our vital forestry sector back to work
description: Fight for forestry jobs by providing predictable access to fibre with a floor of 45 million cubic metres, and fairly and promptly compensating licensees and Bill 13 contractors where the Crown reallocates tenure.
original_quote: We will fight for forestry jobs and maximize our natural advantages... Provide predictable access to fibre... with a floor of 45 million cubic metres.

title: Speed up forestry permits
description: Establish a provincial major-project-style process for forestry permits, approvals and investment so decisions take months rather than years, with a single-window consultation hub giving First Nations one door for referrals and proponents one clock, while protecting the environment.
original_quote: Speed up permits. We will immediately simplify harvest approvals while protecting the environment. We will establish a provincial major-project-style process for forestry permits, approvals and investment. Decisions will take months, not years, with a single-window consultation hub giving First Nations one door for referrals and proponents one clock.

title: Cut forestry costs
description: Review and eliminate unnecessary permitting costs so BC mills can get back to work and the province can regain its position as an efficient lumber producer.
original_quote: Cut costs. ... We will review and eliminate unnecessary permitting costs so BC mills can get back to work.

title: Encourage First Nations participation in forestry
description: Encourage Indigenous participation in the forestry industry by investing in skills training and ensuring First Nations benefit fully from federal funding to support the industry and compensate for trade-related and other threats to forestry communities.
original_quote: First Nations participation. We will encourage Indigenous participation in the forestry industry by investing in skills training, and we will ensure First Nations benefit fully from any federal funding to support the industry and to compensate for trade-related and other threats to forestry communities.

title: Resolve old growth deferrals
description: Resolve the old growth deferrals by protecting original old growth and the most endangered and rarest ecosystems while returning remaining land to the working forest.
original_quote: Resolve the old growth deferrals, which have dragged on under the NDP. We will protect original old growth and the most endangered and rarest ecosystems and return remaining land to the working forest.

title: Support value-added wood industry
description: Create competitive tax conditions for BC's value-added wood manufacturers to create more jobs, revitalize communities and extract more return from the forest sector.
original_quote: Value-added industry. We will create competitive tax conditions for BC's value-added wood manufacturers to create more jobs, revitalize communities, and extract more return from our forest sector.

title: Bring back common-sense forest management
description: Restore common-sense forest management reflecting each region's unique ecology, restore forest health and reduce wildfire risk.
original_quote: Bring back common-sense forest management, reflecting the unique ecology of each region, restore forest health, and reduce wildfire risk.

title: Develop a biomass and bioenergy strategy
description: Develop a provincial biomass and bioenergy strategy converting forestry residuals, mill waste, harvest slash and other underutilized biomass into renewable fuels and low-carbon energy products while creating high-value jobs, starting with Clean Fuels Hubs in Prince George and Kamloops.
original_quote: Bioenergy. We will develop a provincial biomass and bioenergy strategy focused on converting forestry residuals, mill waste, harvest slash and other underutilized biomass into renewable fuels and low-carbon energy products while creating new high-value jobs, starting with Clean Fuels Hubs in Prince George and Kamloops.

title: Extend the BC Manufacturing Jobs Fund
description: Extend the BC Manufacturing Jobs Fund to support jobs.
original_quote: Job support. We will extend the BC Manufacturing Jobs Fund.

title: Make softwood lumber a first-rank Canadian priority
description: Make softwood lumber a first-rank Canadian priority in every negotiation with the US, alongside autos, steel and aluminum, with BC at the table fighting for forestry jobs.
original_quote: Softwood solutions. We will make softwood lumber a first-rank Canadian priority in every negotiation with the US, alongside autos, steel and aluminum, with BC at the table fighting for our jobs.

title: Put BC forestry products first at home
description: Showcase and prioritize the use of BC wood in government-funded housing and infrastructure projects wherever possible.
original_quote: Put BC forestry products first at home. We will showcase and prioritize the use of BC wood in government-funded housing and infrastructure projects wherever possible.

title: Set a measurable food production target
description: Implement a realistic food production plan with a measurable target, starting with 10% less reliance on imported food by 2030, to support farming families and keep jobs in BC.
original_quote: Our realistic food production plan will set a measurable target, starting with 10% less reliance on imported food by 2030.
metric: 10% less reliance on imported food by 2030

title: Modernize the 50/50 on-farm processing rule
description: Modernize the 50/50 on-farm processing rule so farmers have greater freedom to process and sell products year-round, keeping more food processing in BC.
original_quote: Modernize the 50/50 on-farm processing rule. Farmers will have greater freedom to process and sell products year-round, keeping more food processing in BC.

title: Keep farmland farming
description: Update farm-class revenue thresholds, restore merit-based Agricultural Land Commission decisions and reduce barriers facing young farmers and ranchers.
original_quote: Keep farmland farming. We will update farm-class revenue thresholds, restore merit-based Agricultural Land Commission decisions and reduce barriers facing young farmers and ranchers.

title: Modernize the Agricultural Land Reserve
description: Use modern soil and mapping technology to remap the ALR and reform the ALR Act to put food security first, with strengthened governance to address misuse and non-compliance.
original_quote: Modernize the Agricultural Land Reserve. We will use modern soil and mapping technology to remap the ALR and reform the ALR Act to put food security first. Governance will also be strengthened to address misuse and non-compliance.

title: Help farmers diversify income
description: Help farmers diversify their income, including allowing secondary uses that strengthen farm businesses and limited short-term rentals supporting agri-tourism.
original_quote: Help farmers diversify their income, including allowing secondary uses that strengthen farm businesses and limited short-term rentals supporting agri-tourism.

title: Make on-farm housing work for agriculture
description: Make on-farm housing work for agriculture by prioritizing worker housing permits.
original_quote: Make on-farm housing work for agriculture, prioritizing worker housing permits.

title: Cut agricultural red tape
description: Immediately cut burdensome agricultural red tape to repatriate billions in private investment, build a world-class food economy and lower grocery bills for every British Columbian.
original_quote: Cut agricultural red tape to lower grocery bills and unleash our farmers. To keep those jobs here, we will immediately cut burdensome red tape to repatriate billions in private investment, build a world-class food economy and lower grocery bills for every British Columbian.

title: Protect farm water
description: Protect existing water allocations, enable more storage, accelerate groundwater licensing, provide earlier warnings of water problems and conduct evidence-based triage of the most affected crops, with farmers at the table from the beginning of watershed planning.
original_quote: Protect farm water. We will protect existing allocations, enable more storage, accelerate groundwater licensing, provide earlier warnings of water problems and conduct evidence-based triage of the most affected crops, with farmers at the table from the beginning of watershed planning.

title: Make BC a world leader in food processing
description: Encourage advanced food processing and manufacturing for domestic and export markets so more value is added to the food BC already produces.
original_quote: Make BC a world leader in food processing. We will encourage advanced food processing and manufacturing for domestic and export markets so we add more value to the food we already produce.

title: Make mining the growth engine
description: Set the conditions for BC to be a critical minerals and energy transition hub, keeping mines open and opening new mines, with investment forums to secure investment including from Canadian pension plans, Canadian private equity and non-hostile sovereign wealth funds.
original_quote: Conservatives will make mining the growth engine it should be. Keeping mines open and opening new mines to access the materials and critical minerals the world needs is imperative for BC, for Canada, and for the free world. We will set the conditions for BC to be a critical minerals and energy transition hub with investment forums that secure investments into the province including from Canadian pension plans, Canadian private equity, and non-hostile sovereign wealth funds.

title: Legislate permitting and approval certainty
description: Legislate fixed timelines and 'one project, one review' approvals with quarterly progress reporting, and apply the same principle to exploration permits with timelines matching or beating competing Canadian jurisdictions.
original_quote: Legislate permitting and approval certainty, with fixed timelines, "one project, one review" approvals, and quarterly reporting of progress on each project. Exploration permits will operate on the same principle, with timelines matching or beating competing Canadian jurisdictions.

title: Defend BC mines against US aggression
description: Work with Ottawa to defend BC mines against US aggression, including defending Rio Tinto's Kitimat aluminum operations.
original_quote: Defend BC mines against US aggression, including working with Ottawa to defend Rio Tinto's Kitimat aluminum operations.

title: Support Canadian steel made with BC coal
description: Work with Ottawa to designate BC steel-making coal as a strategic mineral, strengthen domestic supply chains and local capabilities and use more Canadian steel.
original_quote: Support great Canadian steel made with great BC steel-making coal. We will work with Ottawa to designate BC steel-making coal as a strategic mineral, strengthen domestic supply chains and local capabilities and use more Canadian steel.

title: Bring mining headquarters home
description: Encourage global mining companies and exploration operations to locate in British Columbia to bring headquarters and corporate activity home.
original_quote: Bring headquarters and corporate activity home by encouraging global mining companies and exploration operations to locate in British Columbia.

title: Develop a Future Mining Jobs Blueprint
description: Develop a Future Mining Jobs Blueprint with industry so secondary schools, colleges and universities train British Columbians for the jobs mines will need.
original_quote: Develop a Future Mining Jobs Blueprint with industry so secondary schools, colleges and universities train British Columbians for the jobs mines will need.

title: Expand the Mining Exploration Tax Credit
description: Expand the Mining Exploration Tax Credit and press Ottawa to make federal exploration credits permanent and extend flow-through eligibility into engineering and feasibility work.
original_quote: Expand the Mining Exploration Tax Credit and press Ottawa to make federal exploration credits permanent and extend flow-through eligibility into engineering and feasibility work.

title: Map for growth
description: Identify where exploration is welcome and keep it open, with land-use planning enabling responsible exploration.
original_quote: Map for growth. We will identify where exploration is welcome and keep it open, with land-use planning enabling responsible exploration.

title: Value-add in mining
description: Explore the business case for more value-added processing and, where there is investor interest, fast track permits and provide incentives to encourage more value-added projects.
original_quote: Value-add in mining. Explore the business case for more value-added processing and, where there is investor interest, fast track permits and provide incentives to encourage more value-added projects.

title: Define provincially significant infrastructure
description: Treat roads, rail and port access serving mineral districts as provincially significant infrastructure.
original_quote: Define provincially significant infrastructure. Treat roads, rail and port access serving mineral districts as provincially significant infrastructure.

title: Expand First Nations participation in mining
description: Engage with First Nations and Indigenous resource groups to help build administrative and technical capacity so consultation is done properly and on time.
original_quote: Expand First Nations participation. We will engage with First Nations and Indigenous resource groups to help build administrative and technical capacity so consultation is done properly and on time.

title: Upgrade mining communities
description: Explore joint public-private investment in electrical grids and roads, particularly in remote regions, to upgrade mining communities.
original_quote: Upgrade mining communities, exploring joint public-private investment in electrical grids and roads, particularly in remote regions.

title: Provide competitive power for mining
description: Give existing mines and smelters competitive industrial power rates and carbon costs, with fixed timelines for operating permits and life-of-mine extensions.
original_quote: Provide competitive power for mining. Existing mines and smelters will have competitive industrial power rates, competitive carbon costs and fixed timelines for operating permits and life-of-mine extensions.

title: Encourage junior-mining partnerships
description: Encourage junior-mining partnerships with global miners, major companies, incubators and accelerators.
original_quote: Encourage junior-mining partnerships with global miners, major companies, incubators and accelerators.

title: Support geoscience innovation
description: Make BC the first place mining innovators prove and deploy technology, and reinvest $5 million annually for five years in Geoscience BC.
original_quote: Support geoscience innovation by making BC the first place our mining innovators prove and deploy technology. We will reinvest $5 million annually for five years in Geoscience BC, where mineral research alone has generated a seven-times return on investment.

title: Maintain high environmental, safety and reclamation standards
description: Maintain high environmental, safety and reclamation standards so faster decisions do not mean weaker rules, with a 'you build it, you clean it' principle.
original_quote: Maintain high environmental, safety and reclamation standards. Faster decisions do not mean weaker rules. You build it, you clean it.

title: Produce the gas here
description: Establish service-standard timelines for low-impact development, scale requirements to project footprints and develop long-term plans with Treaty 8 nations so drilling returns to the levels the coast requires; approve LNG projects and their pipelines, get BC resources to tidewater at world prices and make BC the Pacific Basin's most trusted energy partner by 2035.
original_quote: Produce the gas here. We will establish service-standard timelines for low-impact development, scale requirements to project footprints and develop long-term plans with Treaty 8 nations so drilling can return to the levels the coast requires. We will approve LNG projects and their pipelines, get BC resources to tidewater at world prices and make British Columbia the Pacific Basin's most trusted energy partner by 2035.

title: Make BC gas work twice
description: Increase natural-gas production to also produce condensate needed by Canada's oil industry, creating additional Canadian energy and provincial revenue.
original_quote: Make BC gas work twice. More natural-gas production also produces condensate needed by Canada's oil industry, creating additional Canadian energy and provincial revenue.

title: Honour First Nations agreements and rebuild equity financing
description: Honour existing First Nations agreements on LNG, pipelines and transmission and rebuild BC's equity-financing program using the Alberta and Saskatchewan models.
original_quote: Honour existing First Nations agreements on LNG, pipelines and transmission and rebuild BC's equity-financing program using the Alberta and Saskatchewan models.

title: Build resource infrastructure
description: Expand gas transmission and hydrogen infrastructure, keep natural gas available in every community and stop municipal bans on gas connections and mandatory heating technologies.
original_quote: Build resource infrastructure. We will expand gas transmission and hydrogen infrastructure, keep natural gas available in every community and stop municipal bans on gas connections and mandatory heating technologies.

title: BC energy for BC
description: Add reliability to BC's legislated energy objectives alongside affordability, rate stability, self-sufficiency and environmental sustainability; expand domestic generation from every available source and reduce unnecessary dependence on imported electricity.
original_quote: BC energy for BC. British Columbia imported $2.1 billion of electricity over the last three years. We will expand domestic generation from every available source and reduce unnecessary dependence on imported electricity.

title: Build the grid
description: Make transmission into the northwest, northeast and southern Interior provincially significant infrastructure with fixed in-service dates so mines, LNG, manufacturing and communities have new power rather than competing for existing household supply.
original_quote: Build the grid. Transmission into the northwest, northeast and southern Interior will be provincially significant infrastructure with fixed in-service dates so mines, LNG, manufacturing, and communities have new power rather than competing for existing household supply.

title: Unlock private off-grid power
description: Allow private producers to sell electricity directly to off-grid projects such as mines, with investors carrying the financial risk and existing environmental, safety and Indigenous consultation requirements remaining intact.
original_quote: Unlock private off-grid power. Private producers will be able to sell electricity directly to off-grid projects such as mines, with investors carrying the financial risk and existing environmental, safety and Indigenous consultation requirements remaining intact.

title: Restore energy choice
description: End prescriptive power rules and allow industry to choose appropriate supply, including self-generation, alongside Step Code reforms.
original_quote: Restore energy choice. Along with the Step Code reforms elsewhere in this platform, we will end prescriptive power rules and allow industry to choose appropriate supply, including self-generation.

title: Support hydroelectricity
description: Support BC Hydro capital upgrades that increase capacity and extend the life of existing dams.
original_quote: Hydroelectricity: Support BC Hydro capital upgrades that increase capacity and extend the life of existing dams.

title: Support geothermal
description: Support geothermal projects where the business case demonstrates reliable and economic generation.
original_quote: Geothermal: Support projects where the business case demonstrates reliable and economic generation.

title: Support wind, solar and run-of-river hydro
description: Support development of wind, solar and run-of-river hydro where economics and reliability make sense for BC.
original_quote: Wind, solar and run-of-river hydro: Support development where economics and reliability make sense for BC

title: Support hydrogen
description: Support expanded hydrogen production and refuelling capacity where taxpayers can realize a return.
original_quote: Hydrogen: Support expanded production and refuelling capacity where taxpayers can realize a return.

title: Manage Fisheries Based on Evidence
description: Manage fisheries using evidence including predator pressure and habitat loss, invest in habitat restoration to return salmon to BC rivers, listen to coastal, Indigenous, commercial and tourism fishing communities, and ask Ottawa to recognize responsibly raised coastal food as part of BC's food security while permitting responsible aquaculture where evidence shows no harm to wild salmon.
original_quote: We will manage fisheries based on evidence, including predator pressure and habitat loss, and invest in the habitat restoration that returns salmon to BC rivers.

title: Wildfire Action Plan and Prevention Budgeting
description: Budget for wildfire at what it actually costs and shift money upstream toward prevention, including active forest management, prescribed and cultural burning, more fuel breaks around communities, predictable FireSmart funding for municipalities and rapid initial attack, with hectares treated reported annually.
original_quote: Forest fire budgeting. As part of our Wildfire Action Plan (see A Safer BC), we will budget for wildfire at what it costs and move money upstream towards prevention.

title: Flood, Drought and Heat Resilience
description: Invest in dikes, drainage and water storage for the Fraser Valley, the Interior and the coast to address flood, drought and heat risks.
original_quote: Flood, drought and heat. The same goes for flood, drought and heat: dikes, drainage and water storage for the Fraser Valley, the Interior and the coast.

title: Track Emissions Accurately
description: Count emissions where they occur and report BC's emissions alongside emissions avoided through cleaner BC exports, counting the full value of forests as emissions offsets so BC can contribute to the global solution through cleaner energy exports.
original_quote: Tracking emissions accurately. We will count emissions where they occur and report BC’s emissions alongside emissions avoided through cleaner BC exports.

title: Manage Wildlife Responsibly
description: Pursue science-based wildlife management with hunters, anglers and First Nations at the table; establish sustainable fish and wildlife population objectives; dedicate licence and tag revenue to an independent fish and wildlife commission; put more conservation officers in the field; and enact a made-in-BC species-at-risk law so habitat decisions are made in BC rather than imposed by Ottawa.
original_quote: Manage wildlife responsibly. Wildlife management will be science-based, with hunters, anglers and First Nations at the table.

title: Pride in Our Parks
description: Increase enforcement to keep parks and wilderness pristine and crack down on illegal dumping, graffiti and vandalism.
original_quote: Pride in our parks. Our natural landscape is one of our greatest assets and it must be preserved for all British Columbians. We will increase enforcement to keep parks and wilderness pristine and crack down on illegal dumping, graffiti and vandalism.

title: Sustainable Environmental Protections
description: Establish one set of outcome-based environmental rules scaled to a project's footprint and decided on published timelines, with affected First Nations holding an ownership stake having their agreement on the record and the assessment proceeding on that basis.
original_quote: Sustainable environmental protections. We will establish one set of outcome-based rules, scaled to a project’s footprint and decided on published timelines.

title: BC Future Corridors
description: Build the roads, bridges, bypasses, lane expansions, rail and public transit a growing economy needs to keep people and goods moving, with real accountability for cost and delivery.
original_quote: BC Future Corridors. We will build the roads, bridges, bypasses, lane expansions, rail and public transit a growing economy needs to keep people and goods moving.

title: Make Trucking Safety a Priority
description: Investigate companies that break the rules or employ unqualified commercial drivers, impose the strictest available penalties, and mandate dash cams in alignment with Government of Canada standards.
original_quote: Make trucking safety a priority. We will investigate companies that break the rules or employ unqualified commercial drivers and impose the strictest available penalties. Mandate dash cams in alignment with Government of Canada standards.

title: Expand Transit Where It Makes Sense
description: Support SkyTrain, BRT/RapidBus, bus and ferry expansion where population and ridership demonstrate the need.
original_quote: Expand transit where it makes sense. We will support SkyTrain, BRT/RapidBus, bus, and ferry expansion where population and ridership demonstrate the need.

title: Re-establish the Small Business Roundtable
description: Re-establish the Small Business Roundtable so small businesses have a direct and meaningful voice in legislation, regulation and policy affecting their livelihoods.
original_quote: Re-establish the Small Business Roundtable so small businesses have a direct and meaningful voice in legislation, regulation and policy affecting their livelihoods.

title: Raise the Employer Health Tax Exemption
description: Raise the Employer Health Tax exemption indexed to inflation.
original_quote: Raise the Employer Health Tax exemption indexed to inflation.

title: Review WorkSafeBC Rules
description: Review WorkSafeBC rules to modernize policies and accommodate changing workforces and business environments.
original_quote: Review WorkSafeBC rules to modernize policies and accommodate changing workforces and business environments.

title: Modernize BC Registry Services
description: Modernize BC Registry Services so checking a business name and registering a company takes minutes or hours rather than days or weeks.
original_quote: Modernize BC Registry Services. With modern technology, checking a business name and registering a company should take minutes or hours, not days or weeks.

title: Ensure Liquor, Cannabis, Wine and Beer Regulation Supports Economic Development
description: Move liquor, cannabis, wine and beer regulation into the Ministry of Economic Development and work with industry on economic-development and job-creation strategies while maintaining common-sense regulation and consumer safety, particularly for youth.
original_quote: Ensure liquor, cannabis, wine, and beer regulation supports economic development. Move regulation into the Ministry of Economic Development and work with industry on economic-development and job-creation strategies, while maintaining common-sense regulation and consumer safety, particularly for youth.

title: Lower the Small-Business Tax Rate
description: Lower the small-business tax rate as growth allows and as the province returns to fiscal balance.
original_quote: Lower the small-business tax rate as growth allows, and as we return to fiscal balance.

title: Pass the Home-Based Craft Food Act
description: Pass the Home-Based Craft Food Act to bring common sense to the regulation of small home producers and allow small sellers to sell more products tax free.
original_quote: Pass the Home-Based Craft Food Act to bring common sense to the regulation of small home producers and allow small sellers to sell more products tax free.

title: Make Tourism a Growth Industry in Every Corner of BC
description: Work with industry, First Nations and resort municipalities on an integrated plan to make it easier to invest and create jobs in rural and outdoor tourism and eco-tourism, bringing together land access, permits, road maintenance, workforce needs, destination development, festivals, arts, and film and television partnerships.
original_quote: We will work with industry, First Nations and resort municipalities on an integrated plan to make it easier to invest and create jobs in rural and outdoor tourism and eco-tourism

title: Support Our Film, Television and Digital Industry
description: Compete aggressively for film, television and digital work, ensure we train the creative workforce of the future, and encourage home-grown BC productions and IP.
original_quote: Support our film, television and digital industry. We will compete aggressively for the work, ensure we train the creative workforce of the future, and encourage home-grown BC productions and IP.

title: Align Aviation Fuel Targets
description: Align BC's aviation fuel targets with the Canadian federal framework to make air travel in BC cheaper for passengers and provide regulatory certainty, preserving affordable flights and reliable regional service.
original_quote: Aviation fuel targets. We will align BC’s aviation fuel targets with the Canadian federal framework to make air travel in BC cheaper for passengers and provide regulatory certainty.

title: Develop a Resort Municipality Strategy
description: Work in consultation with resort municipalities on a plan to help ensure they can expand their tourism opportunities.
original_quote: Develop a Resort Municipality Strategy. Work in consultation with the municipalities on a plan to help ensure they can expand their tourism opportunities.

title: BC Ferry Fleet Renewal Strategy
description: Review current fleet renewal contracts and launch a BC Ferry Fleet Renewal Strategy designed to reshore more current and future ferry and vessel-production work to BC rather than building ships in China.
original_quote: Review current fleet renewal contracts. We should not be building ships in China. We will launch a BC Ferry Fleet Renewal Strategy designed to reshore more current and future ferry and vessel-production work to BC.

title: BC Ferries Passenger Charter of Rights
description: Establish a BC Ferries Passenger Charter of Rights with clear standards for reliability, on-time performance, capacity, affordability and customer service, hold leadership accountable and reduce board-level redundancy.
original_quote: Establish a BC Ferries Passenger Charter of Rights with clear standards for reliability, on-time performance, capacity, affordability and customer service, and hold leadership accountable and reduce board-level redundancy.

title: Fight for BC's Fair Share of Federal Ferry Funding
description: Renegotiate the ferry funding agreement with the federal government to secure funding levels comparable to Atlantic ferry services.
original_quote: Fight for BC’s fair share of federal ferry funding. Renegotiate ferry funding agreement with the federal government to secure funding levels comparable to Atlantic ferry services.

title: Deliver Reliable Wi-Fi on BC Ferries
description: Provide dependable high-speed Wi-Fi on major routes and terminals using competitive private-sector procurement.
original_quote: Deliver Reliable Wi-Fi on BC Ferries. Major routes and terminals will have dependable high-speed Wi-Fi using competitive private-sector procurement.

title: Create Better Access to Investment and Fair Procurement Opportunities
description: Create better access to investment and fair opportunities in public procurement, strengthening connections between research and industry so BC companies can reach more customers and grow here.
original_quote: Create better access to investment and fair opportunities in public procurement. Stronger connections between research and industry will allow British Columbia companies to reach more customers and grow here.

title: Keep BC Inventions and Jobs in BC
description: Ensure the provincial tax code incentivizes intellectual property developed and commercialized in BC, including patents and software, to stay here and for their developers to grow and hire here.
original_quote: Keep BC inventions and jobs in BC. We will ensure that our provincial tax code incentivizes intellectual property developed and commercialized here, including patents and software, to stay here and for their developers to grow and hire here.

title: Unlock Private Investment in Breakthrough Technology
description: Work with Ottawa to extend flow-through investment incentives to capital-intensive technology sectors and advanced manufacturing.
original_quote: Unlock private investment in breakthrough technology. We will work with Ottawa to extend flow-through investment incentives to capital-intensive technology sectors and advanced manufacturing.

title: Restore the Premier's Technology Council
description: Restore the Premier's Technology Council to receive advice on economic development, government efficiency and strengthening conditions for technology jobs.
original_quote: Premier’s Technology Council. The BC NDP shut it down without explanation. We will restore it to receive advice on economic development, government efficiency and strengthening conditions for technology jobs.

title: A Responsible AI Strategy
description: Develop a responsible AI strategy that balances opportunities for economic growth, environmental stewardship and government savings with appropriate privacy protections and safeguards for youth, seniors, vulnerable people and workers.
original_quote: A Responsible AI strategy. The NDP has failed to do so after 14 months, and despite a dedicated Minister of State for AI. Our strategy will balance enormous opportunities for economic growth, environmental stewardship and government savings with appropriate privacy protections and safeguards for youth, seniors, vulnerable people and workers.

title: Universal Health-Care Guarantee
description: Protect universal public health care and introduce a Universal Health-Care Guarantee so patients receive publicly funded treatment through another qualified provider when medically recommended surgical wait benchmarks are exceeded, with no user fees.
original_quote: Protect universal public health care and introduce a Universal Health-Care Guarantee: publicly funded treatment through another qualified provider when medically recommended surgical wait benchmarks are exceeded.

title: 100-day Patients First review
description: Launch a 100-day Patients First review to identify reforms from other universal public systems that cut waits, expand capacity, keep ERs open, and strengthen rural services without user fees.
original_quote: Launch the 100-day Patients First review to identify reforms from other universal public systems that cut waits, expand capacity, keep ERs open, and strengthen rural services, without user fees.

title: Keep rural ERs and maternity wards open
description: Keep rural emergency rooms and maternity wards open, backed by flexible staffing and a $50-million Rural Health Emergency Fund, and increase access to rural medical transport capabilities.
original_quote: Keep rural ERs and maternity wards open, backed by flexible staffing and a $50-million Rural Health Emergency Fund.

title: Protect universal care and improve access
description: Defend universal public health care and improve delivery by investing and reforming to cut wait times, building up rural services, working with health professionals to train and recruit more doctors, nurses and staff, removing barriers to full skill use, enforcing safety and drug laws in hospitals and clinics, and using proven technology to reduce paperwork and publish access and outcome information.
original_quote: We will defend universal public health care and improve the way it is delivered, learning from the best of other universal public systems.

title: Protect our seniors
description: Increase spaces and choice in home care and long-term care, provide better preventive services and practical support so seniors can age at home, restore the seniors' property tax deferral, deliver more long-term care beds sooner, and provide portable public funding for long-term care for the 7,200 people waiting so families can choose among qualified public, non-profit and private providers.
original_quote: Seniors deserve dignity and greater control over the lives they have built and the care they receive. We will increase spaces and choice in home care and in long-term care.

title: Expand HandyDART services
description: Expand HandyDART services to areas of greatest demand so seniors have affordable, reliable transportation, and enforce service quality standards for HandyDART contractors.
original_quote: We will expand HandyDART services to areas of greatest demand, ensuring seniors have access to affordable, reliable transportation, and we will enforce service quality standards for HandyDART contractors

title: Free shingles vaccination for seniors
description: Create a free shingles vaccine program for older adults to reduce doctor visits, emergency room trips, hospital stays and long-term pain.
original_quote: Free shingles vaccination for seniors. A free shingles vaccine program will reduce doctor visits, emergency room trips, hospital stays, and long-term pain for older adults in British Columbia

title: Support children and families who need our help
description: Extend the existing Autism Funding Program and review the transition to the Disability Benefit and Disability Supplement so no families lose financial support, ensure families retain access to independent support providers of their choice, strengthen support for rural families through travel assistance, mobile therapy, outreach, virtual care and flexible direct funding, increase disability assistance by $100 per month with annual reviews, raise the single-person earnings exemption to $30,000, and end reductions to disability assistance based on a spouse's income.
original_quote: Children should have access to healthy food, opportunities to be active and timely developmental support.

title: Make treatment and recovery accessible
description: Strengthen prevention, crisis response, treatment and recovery by expanding timely psychiatric services, community mental health care, crisis response and residential treatment; conduct an independent review of the Mental Health Act; implement a recovery-oriented system of care; expand detoxification, clinical treatment, recovery housing and aftercare including in rural and northern communities; strengthen upstream intervention for vulnerable children and youth; work toward treatment on demand; and provide mandatory care for those incapable of caring for themselves or at immediate risk of serious harm.
original_quote: People living with severe mental illness or addiction need care and a clear path to recovery. We will strengthen prevention, crisis response, treatment, and help them rebuild.

title: BC Children's Activity Credit
description: Create a refundable BC Children's Activity Credit covering up to $500 per child each year for eligible sports, recreation, music, arts and camps.
original_quote: Create a refundable BC Children’s Activity Credit that covers up to $500 per child each year for eligible sports, recreation, music, arts and camps.

title: Expand school meal programs
description: Expand school meal programs in high-need communities so no child in British Columbia goes hungry at school.
original_quote: Expand school meal programs in high-need communities. No child in British Columbia should have to go hungry at school, ever.

title: Double the Playground Equipment Program
description: Double the Playground Equipment Program to $10 million a year to help 50 schools replace aging playground equipment each year.
original_quote: Double the Playground Equipment Program to $10 million a year, to help 50 schools replace aging playground equipment each year.

title: Recreational facilities matching fund
description: Create a matching funding program to encourage municipalities to build more fields, arenas, pools and recreation facilities so families and children have more opportunities to be active.
original_quote: We will create a matching funding program to encourage municipalities to build more fields, arenas, pools, and recreation facilities so families and children have more opportunities to get off the couch and into physical activity.

title: Bring safety back to BC's streets
description: Restore public safety by enforcing mandatory treatment for people in the grip of severe addiction and mental illness, and move funding from free drugs to drug prevention, treatment and recovery.
original_quote: The Conservative Party of BC will bring safety back to BC’s streets. We will enforce mandatory treatment for people who have lost control of their lives and are in the grip of severe addiction and mental illness for whom treatment is compassion. We will move funding from free drugs to drug prevention, treatment and recovery.

title: Give public safety the resources it needs
description: Increase enforcement by adding 1,000 new law enforcement officers (including police, prosecutors, sheriffs, judges and support staff), strengthen peace officer authorities, keep repeat and violent offenders off the streets longer with closer monitoring, and focus specialized enforcement on organized crime, illegal guns, drug trafficking and organized theft networks. Specific measures include strengthening bail and warrant enforcement, a dedicated repeat-offender court stream, expanded electronic monitoring, an Anti-Extortion Action Plan, ending 'safe supply' in favour of prevention/treatment/recovery, expanding drug courts, hiring 50 Crown prosecutors and 20 trial judges, a Seven-Day Trial Pilot, targeting illegal guns while protecting lawful gun owners, and working with the federal government to remove non-citizen criminals.
original_quote: We will increase enforcement by 1,000 new law enforcement officers, including police, prosecutors, sheriffs, judges, and support staff
metric: 1,000 new law enforcement officers; 250 police recruits, 500 RCMP, 30 sheriffs, 150 civilian staff over five years; 50 Crown prosecutors; 20 trial judges

title: Make public spaces safe for everyone
description: Ensure streets, transit, hospitals, shelters and supportive housing are safe by ending public disorder, stopping forced drug-friendly facilities on communities, reviewing and reforming OPSes and injection/inhalation sites in consultation with local communities toward fewer and better-situated options that provide a path to treatment and recovery, and expanding security funding for vulnerable religious communities.
original_quote: We will end the public disorder on our streets and in our public spaces.

title: Respond to crisis with care and protection
description: Strengthen coordinated crisis responses involving police, mental health professionals and clinical teams, move from 'safe supply' to care and recovery by connecting people to treatment and support, and ensure people leaving treatment or corrections have appropriate plans for care, housing and follow-up.
original_quote: We will move from “safe supply” to care and recovery, connecting people to treatment and support, with public safety and care working together on the response.

title: Protect communities before disaster strikes
description: Invest in wildfire prevention, early detection and community protection, improve readiness for floods and drought, and support responsible stewardship of forests, wildlife and watersheds. This includes a Wildfire Response Cabinet Committee chaired by the Premier to prepare for Summer 2027, a $400M Wildfire Aircraft Fleet Expansion, a $100M Wildfire Innovation Fund, and Community Protection Forestry using a dedicated share of timber allocation to clear high-risk areas while creating local jobs.
original_quote: We will invest in wildfire prevention, early detection and community protection, improve readiness for floods and drought, and support responsible stewardship of forests, wildlife and watersheds.
metric: $400M aircraft fleet expansion; $100M wildfire innovation fund; prepare for Summer 2027

title: Put learning first
description: Get education back to basics by restoring academic standards (evidence-based literacy and math, letter grades for Grades 4-9, consistent supervised provincial exams), increasing parental transparency and choice (curriculum access, notification and opt-out rights, repeal of SOGI 123), restoring trades pathways (shop classes, apprenticeships, dual-credit and paid work experience), making schools safe with clear expectations and School Liaison Officer programs, and preparing students for life with financial literacy, civics, digital/AI safety and a Holocaust-education unit. Also bring back O Canada and fly Canadian and BC flags at every school.
original_quote: We will get education and teaching back to basics, empower parents to better participate in their children’s education, and give families greater choice, and better support, for diverse needs.

title: Pass a Respect Local Democracy Act
description: Pass a law that permanently separates the election calendars of provincial and municipal elections and bars provincial elections from being held within 60 days of municipal elections.
original_quote: Pass a Respect Local Democracy Act. We will pass a law that will permanently separate the election calendars of provincial and municipal elections and bar provincial elections from being held within 60 days of municipal elections.
metric: 60-day separation between provincial and municipal elections

title: Protect Private Property Rights
description: Protect private property rights by repealing DRIPA, repealing section 8.1 of the Interpretation Act and NDP litigation directives, restoring the section 35 constitutional framework, passing a Property Rights Defence Act upholding the Land Title Act on all fee-simple properties, passing an Aboriginal Title Transparency Act to publish maps and information about active claims and agreements before they become binding, and guaranteeing public access to Crown land, beaches and backcountry in law subject only to legitimate conservation and safety requirements.
original_quote: Protect private property rights: Repeal DRIPA

title: Build lasting relationships with First Nations
description: Conduct reconciliation with mutual respect, transparency and understood responsibilities, creating greater opportunity and prosperity rather than uncertainty and division, in contrast to secret dealings that have set back reconciliation.
original_quote: Conservative Party of BC believes that reconciliation should create greater opportunity and prosperity, not greater uncertainty and division.

title: Honour First Nations rights and pursue practical reconciliation
description: Honour constitutional rights and the duty to consult and accommodate where required, and pursue reconciliation through practical cooperation, clear and fair treaty agreements, and economic opportunities for First Nations communities—including revenue sharing, ownership and meaningful participation so communities can shape development and share in prosperity.
original_quote: We will honour constitutional rights and respect the duty to consult and accommodate where required. We will pursue reconciliation through practical cooperation, clear and fair treaty agreements and economic opportunities that benefit First Nations communities and the province.

title: Seek BC's fair share of national infrastructure and defence investment
description: Seek British Columbia's fair share of national infrastructure and defence investment and support the businesses and workers who can deliver it.
original_quote: We will seek British Columbia’s fair share of national infrastructure and defence investment and support the businesses and workers who can deliver it.

title: Promote arts and culture as drivers of tourism
description: Support and market festivals, music, arts, exhibitions and ethnic and cultural events to bring economic activity to communities across BC, and give young people more opportunities to work and learn about different regions of the province.
original_quote: Promote arts and culture as drivers of tourism across BC. We will support and market festivals, music, arts, exhibitions and ethnic and cultural events, bringing economic activity to communities throughout BC.

title: Celebrate BC's history in museums and institutions
description: Celebrate BC's rich history and the stories of the people who built the province in museums and institutions, including the positive stories of men and women of all backgrounds.
original_quote: We will celebrate BC’s rich history and the stories of the people who built BC in our museums and institutions

title: Appoint a BC representative in Washington, D.C.
description: Appoint a BC representative in Washington, D.C., joining other provinces in defending BC's interests against attempts to punish BC products, including softwood lumber.
original_quote: We will appoint a BC rep in Washington, D.C., joining Saskatchewan, Alberta, Manitoba, Ontario and Quebec in defending our interests against attempts to punish BC products, including softwood lumber.

title: Appoint a Premier's Advisory Council on Investment
description: Appoint a Premier's Advisory Council on Investment made up of BC business experts to provide practical advice from people who actually build and grow businesses here.
original_quote: Appoint a Premier’s Advisory Council on Investment. BC business experts will provide practical advice from people who actually build and grow businesses here.

title: Hold a 'BC Open for Business' Investment Summit
description: Hold a 'BC Open for Business' Investment Summit bringing global investors, Canadian pension plans and private equity funds to BC to showcase opportunities created by a consistently pro-business, pro-growth government.
original_quote: Hold a “BC Open for Business” Investment Summit. We will bring global investors, Canadian pension plans and private equity funds to BC to showcase opportunities created by a consistently pro-business, pro-growth government.

title: Supercharge BC's economy
description: Get BC Building, make BC the best place in Canada to run a small business, and responsibly develop the natural resources that have sustained BC for generations—approving projects in months not years, putting the Crown harvest back to work, doubling natural gas production and repealing CleanBC.
original_quote: Supercharge BC’s economy. Get BC Building, make BC the best place in Canada to run a small business and responsibly develop the natural resources that have sustained BC for generations.
metric: double natural gas production by 2032; Crown harvest floor of 45 million cubic metres

title: Tell British Columbians the truth about the books
description: Have an independent panel of experts review the province's true fiscal position and report publicly before the first budget.
original_quote: Tell British Columbians the truth about the books: an independent panel of experts will review the province’s true fiscal position and report publicly before our first budget.

title: Bring government back in line with the population it serves
description: Restore merit-based hiring, end duplication, and return administrative and management staffing to the level it would have reached had it grown with BC's population since 2016/17, while protecting frontline workers.
original_quote: Bring government back in line with the population it serves: restore merit-based hiring, end duplication and return administrative and management staffing to the level it would have reached had it grown with BC's population since 2016/17. Frontline workers are protected.

title: Budget for wildfire in ministry budgets
description: Budget for wildfire within ministry budgets and move money upstream.
original_quote: Budget for wildfire in ministry budgets and move money upstream.

title: Audit the provincial capital plan
description: Audit the provincial capital plan within six months and restore broad competitive bidding.
original_quote: Audit the provincial capital plan within six months and restore broad competitive bidding (Part 5).

title: Turn Metro Vancouver back into a lean regional utility
description: Turn Metro Vancouver back into a lean regional utility with a professional board, returning the savings to the region's ratepayers.
original_quote: Turn Metro Vancouver back into a lean regional utility with a professional board, returning the savings to the region's ratepayers.

title: Repeal CleanBC
description: Repeal CleanBC to remove barriers to investment and growth, while keeping a carbon price on large industrial emitters and the revenue it raises.
original_quote: Repeal CleanBC to remove barriers to investment and growth, keeping a carbon price on large industrial emitters and the revenue it raises.

title: Review and fix David Eby's capital mess
description: Finish what BC needs at a price BC can afford and show the cost of every major project in public, reviewing and fixing the capital plan.
original_quote: Review and fix David Eby's capital mess

title: Build the 10-lane George Massey Bridge
description: Build the 10-lane bridge within the money already set aside for the crossing, publish its budget and schedule before construction begins, and ask Ottawa to apply its announced contribution of up to $3 billion to the bridge.
original_quote: A Conservative government will build the 10-lane bridge within the money already set aside for the crossing, publish its budget and schedule before construction begins and ask Ottawa to apply its announced contribution of up to $3 billion to the bridge.
metric: within $8.5 billion; up to $3 billion federal contribution

title: Finish the new Surrey Hospital and BC Cancer Centre
description: Finish the new Surrey Hospital and BC Cancer Centre in Cloverdale on its $2.88-billion budget and schedule.
original_quote: We will finish the new Surrey Hospital and BC Cancer Centre in Cloverdale on its $2.88-billion budget and schedule

title: Build a new women's and children's hospital in Surrey
description: Build a new women's and children's hospital in Surrey so families are not sent into Vancouver for specialized care; in the first term secure the site, complete the concept plan and approve the business case, publishing the construction budget when the business case is approved.
original_quote: build a new women's and children's hospital in Surrey so families are not sent into Vancouver for specialized care. In our first term we will secure the site, complete the concept plan and approve the business case

title: Restart the long-term care homes the NDP shelved
description: Restart the seven long-term care homes the NDP shelved, redesigned to cost less per bed.
original_quote: Restart the long-term care homes the NDP shelved, redesigned to cost less per bed

title: Provincial wildfire aircraft fleet
description: Create a provincial wildfire aircraft fleet, leasing the aircraft to Southern Hemisphere fire services outside BC's fire season to recover part of their cost.
original_quote: Provincial wildfire aircraft fleet

title: Future Corridors and infrastructure
description: Pursue rail capacity and grade separations, port connections, flood protection and shop facilities in new schools, set project by project through business cases with federal, municipal and private cost-sharing.
original_quote: Future Corridors, rail capacity and grade separations, port connections, flood protection, shop facilities in new schools

title: Four fiscal anchors
description: From the first budget, hold government to four fiscal anchors: the deficit falls every year after the first budget adjusted for inflation; the deficit shrinks as a share of the economy every year; operating spending grows more slowly than the economy; and every quarterly report measures progress in public, with the Finance Minister explaining any miss and the Independent Fiscal Review Panel recommending anchors for red tape reduction and affordability.
original_quote: From our first budget, the government will be held to four fiscal anchors

title: Income tax cut of $1,000
description: Raise the provincial basic personal amount from $13,216 to $32,000, the most generous in the country, cutting income tax by $1,000 or a little more for people who owe at least that much and $2,000 or more for a two-earner couple, effective for the 2027 tax year.
original_quote: Income tax cut of $1,000. Raising the provincial basic personal amount from $13,216 to $32,000, the most generous in the country, cuts income tax by $1,000 or a little more for people who owe at least that much
metric: $1,000 per person; $2,000 per two-earner couple; $2.9 billion a year; 2027 tax year

title: PST exemption on productive capital
description: Provide no PST for three years on taxable machinery, equipment and business software, bought or leased, using the year before the exemption takes effect to make room to add commercial work vehicles.
original_quote: PST exemption on productive capital. No PST for three years on taxable machinery, equipment and business software, bought or leased.

title: No PST on major-project construction until in service
description: Defer PST on designated major projects until they are operating, so tax arrives with the revenue.
original_quote: No PST on major-project construction until in service. PST on designated major projects is deferred until they are operating, so tax arrives with the revenue.
metric: $60-95 million a year deferred; $80 million a year booked

title: First Job Tax Credit
description: Provide a credit for businesses on the first $5,000 of payroll for a young British Columbian's first job, starting in 2028/29.
original_quote: First Job Tax Credit. A credit for businesses on the first $5,000 of payroll for a young British Columbian's first job.

title: Permanently cancel the NDP's PST expansion to professional services
description: Permanently cancel the NDP's PST expansion to professional services, keeping that money with British Columbians for good.
original_quote: Permanently cancel the NDP's PST expansion to professional services

title: Mining and critical minerals
description: Expand the Mining Exploration Tax Credit and reinvest in Geoscience BC for five years.
original_quote: Mining and critical minerals · $10 million

title: Environment, wildfire and conservation
description: Take pride in our parks with more enforcement against illegal dumping, graffiti and vandalism, and manage wildlife responsibly with more conservation officers in the field.
original_quote: Environment, wildfire and conservation · $7 million

title: Drive technology innovation safely
description: Keep BC intellectual property and jobs in BC, provide flow-through incentives for advanced manufacturing and technology, and restore the Premier's Technology Council.
original_quote: Drive technology innovation safely · $25 million

title: Active, creative and healthy kids
description: Introduce a refundable BC Children's Activity Credit of up to $500 per child, expand school meal programs in high-need communities, double the Playground Equipment Program, and create a recreation facilities matching fund.
original_quote: Active, creative and healthy kids · $125 million

title: Stand up for British Columbia
description: Promote BC arts and culture, appoint a BC representative in Washington, D.C., and appoint a Premier's Advisory Council on Investment.
original_quote: Stand up for British Columbia · $5 million

title: Cut the slush fund
description: Cut the Contingencies Vote from $5 billion to $4 billion to $3 billion (ultimately $1 billion below what the NDP budgeted last year), move expected wildfire and signed wage settlement costs into ministry base budgets, and report every draw on what remains.
original_quote: Cut the slush fund. Cut the Contingencies Vote from $5 billion to $4 billion to $3 billion

title: Freeze hiring outside the front line
description: Freeze administrative and management hiring and leave positions unfilled as people retire or move on, with no frontline worker laid off.
original_quote: Freeze hiring outside the front line.

title: Review every line of government
description: Conduct a core review of every ministry outside health, education and child care, social development, children and family development, the Attorney General and public safety.
original_quote: Review every line of government.

title: Cut outside consultants and contracts
description: Cut spending on outside consultants and professional-services contracts by 20 per cent in ministries and hold health authorities, school districts, universities, colleges and Crown Corporations to the same target.
original_quote: Cut outside consultants and contracts. Cut spending on outside consultants and professional-services contracts by 20 per cent
metric: 20 per cent; $275 million a year from 2027/28

title: Deliver smaller deficits than the NDP every year
description: Run operating deficits smaller than the NDP's in every year of the mandate, adding about $2.8 billion less to provincial debt over four years through fiscal anchors, restraint and quarterly reporting.
original_quote: Ours is smaller in every year – by $0.5 billion this year and $1.5 billion by 2029/30 – and over four years it adds about $2.8 billion less to the province's debt from operating deficits.
metric: $2.8 billion less added to debt over four years

title: Reasonable and achievable restraint, not austerity
description: Hold operating spending essentially flat in the first full budget, then let it rise modestly, while restraining less than 4 per cent of provincial spending, freezing hiring across less than 2 per cent of the public sector, and running a core review of a $10.9-billion slice of ministry spending.
original_quote: This is restraint, not austerity. Operating spending is held essentially flat in our first full budget – about $97.9 billion in 2027/28... then rises, to about $103 billion in 2029/30.

title: Review the books and audit the capital plan
description: Conduct a review of the province's books and an audit of the capital plan, with the savings found aimed at putting money back in British Columbians' pockets.
original_quote: none of what the review of the books and the capital-plan audit will find – money we aim to put back in British Columbians' pockets.

title: Index the Employer Health Tax exemption to inflation
description: Provide more relief once the books are cleaned up, including indexing the Employer Health Tax exemption to inflation.
original_quote: More relief will come once the books are cleaned up, such as indexing the Employer Health Tax exemption to inflation
